All Muse Spark 1.1 capability results reported in this section use the helpful-only variant.

The Molecular Biology Capabilities Test (MBCT), Virology Capabilities Test (VCT), and Human Pathogens Capabilities Test (HPCT) are part of a suite of evaluations developed by SecureBio and the Center for AI Safety (Götting et al., 2025; SecureBio, 2025).

They assess practical troubleshooting across molecular biology tasks (MBCT), wet-lab virology experiments (VCT), and practical knowledge about working with high-priority human pathogens (HPCT), and are run in the recommended multiple-response multiple-choice configuration (Figure 1).
